title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
abstract: arXiv:2610.13060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3

translated_title: KV-Repurpose：一个用于评估非前缀 KV 缓存复用的测试平台
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13060v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型推理服务中的 KV 缓存复用通常仅限于精确的提示词前缀，这导致当同一份检索文档出现在不同的系统提示词、对话历史或动态元数据之后时无法进行复用。我们提出了 KV-Repurpose，一个基于 vLLM 的开源系统，用于开发和评估超越精确前缀限制的分段式 KV 缓存复用。该系统集成了缓存感知的分段调度、提示词构建、容量管理、工作负载生成以及运行时监控。在长上下文基准测试上的实验表明，朴素的分段复用在单文档问答和摘要任务中基本保持了输出质量，但在跨文档推理方面暴露出明显的局限。在一种齐夫分布（Zipfian）的 RAG 风格工作负载下（其中 20% 的请求共享固定前缀），KV-Repurpose 在相同的 30 GB 缓存容量下，实现了远高于前缀缓存的 token 级缓存命中率——63.9% 对比 3（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出基于 vLLM 的开源测试平台 KV-Repurpose，用于开发和评估超越精确前缀限制的分段式 KV 缓存复用，在 RAG 风格工作负载下显著提升缓存命中率并基本保持单文档任务的输出质量。
en_tdlr: KV-Repurpose is an open-source vLLM-based testbed for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes, substantially improving token-level cache hit rates over prefix caching under RAG-style workloads while largely preserving output quality.
